title: Dialogue with Trypho
author: Justin Martyr
summary: Justin's debate with a Jewish teacher; chapters 80-81 set out his thousand-year hope and admit that many faithful Christians disagree.

title: Against Heresies, Book 5
author: Irenaeus of Lyon
summary: Irenaeus' account of the Antichrist, the resurrection and the kingdom of the righteous, including the sayings he credits to the elders and Papias.

title: Church History
author: Eusebius of Caesarea
summary: Preserves fragments of Papias, Gaius and Dionysius, and records the early debate over the thousand years.

title: The City of God, Book 20
author: Augustine of Hippo
summary: Augustine's reading of Revelation 20 as Christ's present reign with his saints, and his account of once holding a spiritual chiliasm.

title: Regnum Caelorum: Patterns of Millennial Thought in Early Christianity
author: Charles E. Hill
summary: A study of early Christian writers arguing that non-chiliast views were more widespread and earlier than often assumed.
note: Not re-checked online in this session.

title: Whose Land? Whose Promise? What Christians Are Not Being Told about Israel and the Palestinians
author: Gary M. Burge
summary: A New Testament scholar on the land promises, their fulfilment in Christ, and the history of Christian Zionism, with attention to Palestinian Christians.
note: Not re-checked online in this session.

title: Our World in Data: child mortality, life expectancy, literacy and conflict deaths
author: Our World in Data, University of Oxford
summary: Long-run data series compiled from historical and UN sources.
note: Figures are rounded from the published series and were not re-checked online in this session.

title: Are earthquakes increasing?
author: US Geological Survey
summary: The USGS explains that the rate of major earthquakes has stayed fairly constant and more are recorded because of better instruments.
note: Not re-checked online in this session.

title: Status of Global Christianity
author: Center for the Study of Global Christianity, Gordon-Conwell Theological Seminary
summary: Annual estimates of Christian numbers worldwide and by continent since 1900.
note: Figures rounded; not re-checked online in this session.

title: Poverty and Inequality Platform
author: World Bank
summary: Global estimates of the share of people living below the international poverty line.
note: Figures rounded; not re-checked online in this session.

title: The Jewish State (Der Judenstaat)
author: Theodor Herzl
summary: The founding text of political Zionism, arguing from European antisemitism for a Jewish national state.

title: UN General Assembly Resolution 181 (II): Future Government of Palestine
author: United Nations
summary: The partition plan proposing separate Jewish and Arab states.

title: On the Road to Armageddon: How Evangelicals Became Israel's Best Friend
author: Timothy P. Weber
summary: A historian's account of dispensationalism and its influence on American support for Israel.
note: Not re-checked online in this session.

title: The Israel of God: Yesterday, Today, and Tomorrow
author: O. Palmer Robertson
summary: A Reformed study of land, people, temple and Romans 11, arguing for fulfilment in Christ with a future for Jewish people in him.
note: Not re-checked online in this session.

title: Has the Church Replaced Israel? A Theological Evaluation
author: Michael J. Vlach
summary: A dispensational critique of supersessionism, giving the strongest case against the fulfilment view.
note: Not re-checked online in this session.
